scenario: An adult polar field glaciologist in a blue-ice tunnel has just restarted a compact borehole sensor; green status lamps and a stable waveform show success while an adult teammate lowers the emergency crank and seals the recovered ice-core sample.
reference_role: sole appearance and identity reference for the main adult subject; no personality, psychology, relationship, or event inference

hard_prompt_evidence.successful_result_phrase: the restored signal is visibly active
hard_prompt_evidence.symmetric_smile_action_phrase: mostly symmetric smile with raised cheeks
hard_prompt_evidence.result_attention_phrase: eyes remain on the successful result
hard_prompt_evidence.post_success_consequence_phrase: collaborator responds to the restored outcome

expected_pixel_gates.expected_observation: Working sensor feedback is legible as the same adult's completed result without relying on a caption.
Both lip corners and cheeks form a mostly symmetric positive action rather than a one-sided smirk.
Eye direction and body orientation stay tied to the successful device or the collaborator sharing it.
Result feedback, release gesture, and teammate response read as immediately after success rather than a posed smile.
